description: React component for a modal dialog that allows adding users to a specific role within the Mattermost admin console. It includes user search, selection, and pagination features.

classes.name: AddUsersToRoleModal
classes.description: React component class for the modal dialog to add users to a role.

methods.name: searchUsersToAdd
methods.description: Filters user profiles starting with a search term.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial user profiles when component mounts.

methods.name: setUsersLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for user fetching.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs user search based on input term.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a user option in the selection list.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a user to the selection.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the selected users to be added to the role.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal component with user search and selection UI.
